name: White Rabbit
source:
A supporting character. The right hand to the Red Queen, she is subservient to those who she views as higher than her and rude to those she views as lower. She acts like a messenger and helper to Alice.

Why does she seem to recognize Alice as someone else?

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/who-is-the-red-queen/]official website[/url]]
